About the site

This project is intentionally lightweight so you can extend it quickly. Astro handles routing, Markdown rendering, and build optimizations while GitHub Pages hosts the generated HTML.

Project layout

  • src/pages contains route-based `.astro` files.
  • src/components stores shared layouts and partials.
  • src/content/posts holds Markdown blog posts with typed frontmatter.
  • public includes any static assets copied directly into the final build.

Deployment

A single GitHub Actions workflow builds the site with withastro/action@v3 and publishes to the gh-pages branch using actions/deploy-pages@v4. Update astro.config.mjs with your domain so links resolve correctly.

Built with Astro · Deploys from GitHub Pages using the official Astro Action
